verdict: Organic activity is softening; paid channels remain paused this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, paid advertising was inactive across all channels, so your Google Business Profile was the only source of direct patient actions — delivering 37 total actions from 341 impressions over 26 active days. Over the past week, however, GBP actions fell sharply (down 77% versus the prior week), and search clicks and website sessions followed the same downward trend, pointing to genuine softening in local demand rather than a data issue. The last three days recorded zero GBP actions, which reinforces that pattern. We're monitoring search visibility closely and evaluating the right moment to reactivate paid campaigns to counter the demand dip.
